title: Identity

commands.report: 135 unit tests pass; pairing/principals suites cover P01-P04 and A03

tests: P01 concurrent redemption of one code yields exactly one principal
P02 cross-account, expired and locked-out pairing attempts are rejected and do not consume the code
P03 a redemption failure leaves the pairing active and creates no principal
P04 disabling a principal revokes bindings and outstanding reply refs
A03 the same userId on two accounts resolves to isolated principals
a permission patch advances the owning account policyRevision
only one enabled owner is allowed per account
plaintext pairing code is never stored; views hide the code hash
